set-variable.name: usagePayload

outbound.log-to-eventhub: @{ var usage = (JObject)context.Variables["usagePayload"]; return new JObject( new JProperty("id", context.RequestId.ToString()), new JProperty("ts", DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("o")), new JProperty("team", (string)context.Variables["team"]), new JProperty("organization", (string)context.Variables["hiveOrganization"]), new JProperty("department", (string)context.Variables["hiveDepartment"]), new JProperty("project", (string)context.Variables["hiveProject"]), new JProperty("user", (string)context.Variables["hiveUser"]), new JProperty("agent", (string)context.Variables["hiveAgent"]), new JProperty("workflow", (string)context.Variables["hiveWorkflow"]), new JProperty("run_id", (string)context.Variables["hiveRunId"]), new JProperty("turn_index", int.Parse((string)context.Variables["turnIndex"])), new JProperty("provider", "__PROVIDER__"), new JProperty("model", context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("x-hive-model", "unattributed")), new JProperty("runtime", (string)context.Variables["hiveRuntime"]), new JProperty("input_tokens", usage["input_tokens"]), new JProperty("cached_tokens", usage["cached_tokens"]), new JProperty("output_tokens", usage["output_tokens"]), new JProperty("latency_ms", (long)(DateTime.UtcNow - (DateTime)context.Variables["requestStarted"]).TotalMilliseconds), new JProperty("status", context.Response.StatusCode.ToString()), new JProperty("estimated", usage["estimated"]), new JProperty("ingest_source", "eventhub"), new JProperty("ingest_error", usage["ingest_error"]) ).ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None); }
